about_gpl_d: LAVRay is free software: you can use it, study it, share it and change it under the terms of the GNU General Public License, version 3 only. It comes with no warranty.
apps_all_d: Every app on this phone goes through the tunnel. LAVRay itself always stays outside it.
apps_except_d: Every app goes through the tunnel except the ones you select; those use your normal connection.
apps_hint: Choose which apps use the VPN.
apps_only_d: Only the apps you select go through the tunnel. All other apps use your normal connection.
apps_only_empty: No app is selected, so all apps use the tunnel for now. Select at least one app.
bk_confirm_phone: The current data will be deleted and replaced with the contents of the backup, including the core secrets. This cannot be undone. Make sure this is the backup you want.
bk_restart_after_d: Close LAVRay and open it again so every part uses the restored data.
bk_restart_warn_d: Restoring replaces all data. Disconnect first. When it finishes, close LAVRay completely and open it again.
chk_d_generic: The check failed. Details are in the log under Diagnostics.
chk_d_v6_unmeasured: Not measured on the phone: LAVRay itself runs outside the tunnel, so its own IPv6 test would prove nothing.
chk_ip_connect: Connect to see the address through the tunnel.
chk_leak_dns_note: DNS leaks are not measured: there is no test domain that would reveal the resolver.
chk_leak_same: Both addresses are the same: traffic of other apps may be leaving the tunnel.
chk_leak_scope: Measured from LAVRay itself: the address it sees directly and through the tunnel. Other apps are not inspected.
chk_route_note: Shows where an address would go under the active routing preset. No traffic is sent.
conn_try_again: Check your network and try again.
cx_leak_clear: No leak found: the address LAVRay sees directly differs from the one through the tunnel.
cx_leak_unchecked: Not checked: one of the two addresses could not be measured this time.
cx_probe_fail: This check did not complete just now.
da_json_invalid: The core did not accept this JSON. Fix it and check again.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, open the log under Diagnostics.
err_invalid: The input could not be read. Check the link or file and try again.
err_notfound: Item not found. Refresh the list and try again.
imp_cam_denied_d: The camera is used only to read QR codes. Allow it in the app settings or pick an image with a QR code.
imp_cam_none_d: This device has no camera. Pick an image with a QR code or paste the link.
imp_done_confirm: Subscription “{name}” already exists. Updating it would remove {remove} servers; confirm on the Subscriptions screen.
imp_done_sub_again: Subscription “{name}” already existed and was updated: {total} servers ({added} added, {removed} removed).
imp_done_unparsed: Lines of the provider's answer that could not be read: {n}.
imp_err_line: Line {line} of what you pasted was refused. Check that link or remove it, then try again.
imp_fileHint_phone: Choose a file: YAML, base64 or a list of links.
imp_file_unreadable: Could not read the file. Choose another one.
imp_issue_rest: The other lines are imported without it.
imp_issue_ss_b64: The key part of this ss:// link is not valid base64. Often the closing = signs were cut off when it was copied; add them or ask for the link again.
imp_issue_ss_method: This ss:// link names a cipher the app does not support.
imp_issue_ss_pair: The key part of this ss:// link has no cipher and password in it.
imp_p_busy: Subscriptions are updating right now. Wait a moment and try again.
imp_p_dup: Every server in this text is already in the list: {n}.
imp_p_hwid: If the provider limits the number of devices, turn on “{switch}” in the subscription settings and update it.
imp_p_nf_again: Subscription “{name}” already exists, but it could not be updated
imp_p_nf_new: Subscription “{name}” is saved, but its servers were not loaded
imp_p_nf_retry: Update it again on the Subscriptions screen, or tap the button once more.
imp_p_none: The core found no server in the text.
imp_prev_doc: A file or text with a list of profiles
imp_pv_sub: Subscription link: the servers load right after you add it
imp_qr_aim: Point the camera at a QR code
imp_qr_hint: Point the camera at a QR code or pick an image that has one. The link from the code opens in the preview.
imp_unrecognized: This is not a link or a profile list. Paste a link such as vless://… or a subscription address.
lic_android_ui: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, AndroidX, kotlinx.coroutines, kotlinx.serialization, CameraX — Apache-2.0
lic_geoData: Separate data files, not part of the program: each set stays under its authors’ own license, named in the notice published with every release.
lic_go: Go runtime and standard library — BSD-3-Clause; other Go modules under their own licenses
lic_source_d: The source code of every release, with the complete list of third-party components and their licenses, is in the project repositories.
main_auto_connect_d: After the phone starts, LAVRay connects the last server. VPN permission must already be granted, otherwise you get a notification.
mux_concurrencyErr: Enter -1 or a number from 1 to 1024
notif_permission_text: Open the app to allow the VPN again.
ra_proc_inert: App rules with no effect on a phone: {n}
ra_proc_note: These rules match a program by its process name (for example chrome.exe). A phone has no such processes, so they do nothing here. They stay in the preset and keep working on a computer.
sa_tunnel_unavailable: Not available on the phone: the core has no local proxy here, so subscriptions are always fetched directly.
set_alwayson_d: Android can start the VPN by itself when the phone boots and bring it back if it stops. Turn it on in the system VPN settings, next to LAVRay.
set_alwayson_note: LAVRay cannot see or change these switches: they belong to Android.
set_battery_d: Usually you do not need to change this: while connected, LAVRay runs as a foreground service with a notification and uses no wake locks or timers. Some phone brands stop background apps anyway; if the connection drops while the screen is off, set LAVRay to “Unrestricted” or “Not optimized”. LAVRay cannot see brand-specific limits.
set_battery_off: LAVRay is excluded from battery optimization.
set_battery_on: Battery optimization is on for LAVRay (the default).
set_lockdown_d: “Block connections without VPN” (lockdown) goes further: while the VPN is down, Android blocks the internet for every app. If your server is unavailable you have no connection until you reconnect or turn the switch off.
set_reconnect: This change applies the next time the tunnel is built.
set_reset_d: The settings on this screen go back to the core defaults. Servers, subscriptions and routing are not touched.
stats_no_session: No tunnel is running. Session figures appear when you connect.
stub_soon: This section is still in development.
sub_err_format: The provider's answer is not a server list (a stub page or an unknown format)
tun_ipv6_d: Off: IPv6 traffic is not routed into the tunnel and uses your normal connection.
tun_mtu_d: Largest packet the tunnel carries. Lower it if some sites hang while others work.
upd_manual_d: LAVRay does not check for updates and never updates itself. When you want a new version, open the releases page, download the file for your phone and install it over this one. Your data is kept.
upd_no_browser: No browser found. Open the address on another device.
